# MEL ONE

> MEL ONE provides Adelaide carpentry, custom joinery, decking, cabinetry and heritage timber restoration. Request a clear quote from one local team. English and 简体中文 content is available below.

## English services
- [Carpentry & Joinery Services Adelaide](https://www.adelaidecarpentryhub.com.au/services/): Choose a timber repair, fitted joinery, outdoor work or construction service.
- [Timber Door & Window Repairs Adelaide](https://www.adelaidecarpentryhub.com.au/services/door-window-repairs/): MEL ONE repairs existing timber doors and windows in Adelaide, starting with what has changed.
- [Timber Rot Repairs Adelaide — Restoration & Maintenance](https://www.adelaidecarpentryhub.com.au/services/restoration-maintenance/): MEL ONE assesses accessible timber damage and discusses repair options for Adelaide homes.
- [Built-in Wardrobes Adelaide — Custom Storage & Shelving](https://www.adelaidecarpentryhub.com.au/services/storage-solutions/): MEL ONE plans built-in wardrobes and storage around what needs a place and how the room is used.
- [Kitchen & Bathroom Cabinetry Adelaide — Custom Joinery](https://www.adelaidecarpentryhub.com.au/services/custom-kitchen-bathroom/): MEL ONE plans and installs kitchen cabinets, vanity joinery and laundry storage around the room, appliances and selected finishes.
- [Outdoor Carpentry Adelaide — Decks, Pergolas & Timber Screens](https://www.adelaidecarpentryhub.com.au/services/outdoor-living/): New outdoor carpentry should suit how you use the yard and how it meets the house.
- [Deck Restoration & Timber Floor Repairs Adelaide](https://www.adelaidecarpentryhub.com.au/services/decking-restoration-flooring/): MEL ONE scopes existing deck restoration and indoor timber-floor work as different tasks.
- [Heritage Carpenter Adelaide — Timber Repairs & Restoration](https://www.adelaidecarpentryhub.com.au/services/heritage-carpentry/): MEL ONE discusses heritage carpentry with retention as the starting point.
- [Framing Carpenter Adelaide — House Framing](https://www.adelaidecarpentryhub.com.au/services/house-framing/): MEL ONE installs timber wall, roof and floor framing to the project drawings.
- [Commercial Carpenter Adelaide — Fitout & Refurbishment](https://www.adelaidecarpentryhub.com.au/services/fitout-refurbishment/): MEL ONE installs and repairs timber partitions, counters, displays and feature finishes in offices, retail and hospitality spaces.
